summary: Tested delete banner/logo feature + explicit logo upload button on /dashboard/profil (frontend, mobile viewport). ALL PASSED: (1) delete-banner red trash chip renders bottom-right next to edit-banner-chip when banner set; ConfirmDialog 'Hapus Banner' opens; Batal cancels with no change; Hapus issues PUT /api/profil_admin with banner_url null, toast 'Banner dihapus' shown, 'Unggah Banner' overlay returns; persists after reload (verified UI reload AND MongoDB banner_url=None). (2) delete-logo 'Hapus Logo' text button renders when logo set; same dialog/toast flow with logo_url null; logo box shows image-plus placeholder and logo-upload-btn flips from 'Ubah Logo' to '+ Tambah Logo'; persists after reload (MongoDB logo_url=None). (3) logo-upload-btn tonal M3Button visible and labeled correctly in both states. (4) Regression: save-profil still saves (profil-success shown), error/confirm dialog behave. Banner & logo values RESTORED in MongoDB after testing and restore verified in UI. Admin password untouched.

delete-logo text button (13px text + 16px icon, no vertical padding) likely under 44px touch target height
